title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 3: David's sons born in Hebron, Abner turns to David, and Joab kills Abner.

questions.text: What happened during the long war between Saul's house and David's house?
questions.explanation: David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul's house grew weaker and weaker.

answers.text: Both houses grew weaker and weaker
David grew stronger, Saul's house weaker
Saul's house grew stronger and stronger

questions.text: Who was David's firstborn son in Hebron?
questions.explanation: His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess.

questions.text: Who was the mother of Absalom?
questions.explanation: The third son was Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur.

questions.text: What was the name of Saul's concubine whom Ishbosheth spoke to Abner about?
questions.explanation: Saul had a concubine whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah.

questions.text: What did Abner ask in anger at Ishbosheth's words?
questions.explanation: Abner was very angry and said, "Am I a dog's head that belongs to Judah?"

answers.text: "Am I a dog's head that belongs to Judah?"
"Who is David, that I should serve him?"

questions.text: What one thing did David require before Abner could see his face?
questions.explanation: David said Abner would not see his face unless he first brought Michal, Saul's daughter.

answers.text: That he bring Michal, Saul's daughter
That he give up his sword

questions.text: Who followed Michal, weeping, as far as Bahurim?
questions.explanation: Ishbosheth took her from her husband Paltiel the son of Laish, who went with her weeping and followed her to Bahurim.

questions.text: How many men came with Abner to David at Hebron?
questions.explanation: Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him, and David made them a feast.

questions.text: Why did Joab strike Abner in the gate at Hebron?
questions.explanation: Joab struck him there so that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

answers.text: For the blood of Asahel his brother

questions.text: What did David swear when the people urged him to eat?
questions.explanation: David swore that he would not taste bread or anything else until the sun went down.

answers.text: He would not eat until the sun went down
He would fast for seven days
He would not eat until Joab was punished
He would eat only at Abner's grave
